author: TylerAP
quote: Waited 13 years for this BS, didn't expect this from rockstar after the masterpiece **** i.e. RDR2. The missions are boring, running at 30fps in 2026. The endings are terrible and it's just a dating sim holding the name of my beloved franchise i.e GTA. But this isn't a GTA game, I don’t know what the hell it is but it's not GTA. GTA didn't restrict us from doing things, it's like a game made by bunch of feminists to cater to woke agenda. Congratulations rockstar you'll make lots of money with it but your credibility will be damaged permanently.
